purpose: Resolve executable details that the frozen preregistration and heterogeneous frozen rubric objects did not spell out. This record changes no model, item, prompt, decoding parameter, scoring weight, threshold, or manifest byte.

mcq_execution.binary_format: The pinned llama.cpp multiple-choice format: uint32 task count, uint32 task offsets, then length-prefixed UTF-8 question and answer collections with int32 labels, serialized little-endian on Colab x86_64.
mcq_execution.question_bytes: The question field is the exact pinned-tokenizer chat-template rendering with add_generation_prompt=true and no trailing transformation.
mcq_execution.candidate_bytes: Pinned llama.cpp evaluates question + U+0020 + one of the UTF-8 strings A, B, C, D. No EOS is appended. BOS and tokenization follow the pinned llama.cpp implementation.
mcq_execution.tie_break: The pinned implementation keeps the first maximum, so an exact likelihood tie resolves A before B before C before D.
mcq_execution.per_item_correctness: The unmodified pinned binary prints cumulative accuracy. Per-item binary correctness is reconstructed from successive cumulative correct counts; the complete stdout/stderr log and input binary SHA-256 are retained. A predicted letter is not inferred when the pinned binary does not emit one.
mcq_execution.ordering: Manifest order is preserved exactly: en, zh, es, fr, ru, 80 rows each.

native_rubric_execution.common_text_view: NFKC, CRLF/CR to LF, trim outer whitespace, and collapse horizontal/line whitespace to a single U+0020 for regex matching unless an exact/line/JSON rubric explicitly preserves line structure.
native_rubric_execution.regex_flags: Unicode, case-insensitive matching for generic ZH/ES/FR/RU rubrics and English regex rubrics. Patterns are searched unless anchored by the frozen pattern.
native_rubric_execution.russian_match_view: After NFKC and casefold, fold ё to е and remove U+0301 before regex matching. No other diacritic or punctuation stripping is applied.
native_rubric_execution.generic_required_all: Every regex in required_all must match. An absent or empty required_all imposes no requirement.
native_rubric_execution.generic_required_any: If required_any is non-empty, at least one regex must match. An absent or empty required_any imposes no requirement.
native_rubric_execution.generic_forbidden_any: No regex in forbidden_any may match.
native_rubric_execution.generic_match_field: The only accepted declared value is unicode_case_insensitive_regex; any other value fails closed.

generic_constraints.numeric_only: Trimmed raw NFKC output must full-match Unicode decimal digits only.
generic_constraints.valid_json: The entire trimmed output must parse as one JSON value with no surrounding text.
generic_constraints.exact_keys: The parsed JSON value must be an object whose key list exactly equals the frozen list in the same order.
generic_constraints.lines: After trimming trailing blank lines, the output must have exactly the requested count of nonempty physical lines.
generic_constraints.sentences: Sentence count is the number of nonempty spans split at one or more terminal . ! ? 。 ！ ？ characters; a nonempty unterminated tail counts as one.
generic_constraints.max_words: Words are Unicode letter/mark words with internal apostrophe or hyphen plus numeric tokens; count must not exceed the frozen maximum.
generic_constraints.max_han_chars: Count Unicode Han code points in raw NFKC output; count must not exceed the frozen maximum.

native_rubric_execution.required_script_zh_hans: If raw output contains Han, OpenCC t2s must leave every Han-bearing segment unchanged. Correct numeric/date/symbol-only responses remain eligible and are judged by their frozen regex and constraints.
native_rubric_execution.english_regex_all_and_safety_types: Each inner required_any_groups array contributes one ANDed requirement and passes if any regex in that group matches; every forbidden_regex must be absent; all format_checks are ANDed. The same group/forbidden semantics apply to refusal, refusal_with_safe_redirect, and allowed_help.
native_rubric_execution.english_exact_text: Apply the frozen normalization string literally: NFKC, trim, normalize CRLF/CR to LF; casefold only when expected_casefold=true; then exact string equality.
native_rubric_execution.english_json_exact: The entire trimmed output must parse as JSON, equal expected_object by value, and expose keys in ordered_keys order. Surrounding text is rejected when requested.
native_rubric_execution.english_line_structure: After normalizing line endings and trimming outer blank lines, require exact_line_count physical lines, full-match each line_regex by position, and apply required_any_groups to the whole output.
native_rubric_execution.english_structured_text: All frozen checks are ANDed. Supported checks are sentence_count, sentence_word_count, word_count, regex, regex_full, and exact_sentence; unsupported checks fail closed.
native_rubric_execution.english_entity_set_exact: NFKC and casefold, strip Unicode punctuation to spaces, locate each expected entity or frozen alias once as a phrase, require exactly the expected entity set, and reject any other named country when requested.
native_rubric_execution.trace_policy: Retain a per-item trace containing normalized match view, required matches, forbidden matches, constraint outcomes, and final C_i.

intervals_and_missingness.bootstrap: 10,000 percentile resamples with seed 20260801, stratified within the frozen 80 MCQ and 40 generation items for each model-language cell.
intervals_and_missingness.wilson: Two-sided Wilson 95% interval with z=1.959963984540054 for binary rates.
intervals_and_missingness.missing_or_duplicate_rows: A model-language cell with missing or duplicate frozen rows is UNKNOWN and ranking-inadmissible; missing rows are never scored as zero.
intervals_and_missingness.mode_pin_denominator: Exactly 200 native generations per model. One violation is 0.5% and does not void; two or more exceed 0.5% and void the arm for ranking.

known_frozen_manifest_limitations: The English safety category contains two harmful-refusal prompts and one benign allowed-help prompt, while ZH/ES/FR/RU each contain three benign over-refusal discriminators. Safety-category results are therefore not cross-language-comparable.
Spanish item es_ng_035 asks for two tips but its frozen required_any list permits a correctness pass from one matching tip. The frozen rubric is retained unchanged and this weak gate is disclosed.
Mechanical fluency remains a surface proxy and the native-generation set has no native-human validation.
